description: This file defines the EmailConfiguration entity class for ORM mapping in the OrangeHRM system. It manages email configuration settings such as SMTP server details and authentication types, with fields for host, port, username, password, and security options.

classes.name: EmailConfiguration
classes.description: Entity class representing email server configuration, with ORM annotations for database mapping and getter/setter methods for fields.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the email configuration record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the email configuration record.

methods.name: getMailType
methods.description: Retrieves the type of email, if specified.

methods.name: getSentAs
methods.description: Returns the email address or name that will be used as sender.

methods.name: setSentAs
methods.description: Sets the sender email address or name.

methods.name: getSmtpPort
methods.description: Returns the SMTP server port number.

methods.name: getSmtpSecurityType
methods.description: Retrieves the SMTP security type (e.g., TLS/SSL).
